title: markdown-file payload
description: One tracked markdown file: its frontmatter facts, its headings, the links either way, and its source.

type.description: The frontmatter type, null when the file carries none.

title.description: The frontmatter title, null when the file carries none.

description.description: The frontmatter description, null when the file carries none.

words.description: The word count of the body after the frontmatter.

headings.description: Every heading outside a fence, in document order.

links_out.description: Every link the file makes, in reading order.

links_in.description: The sorted identities of the other markdown files that link here.

source.description: The file as written, frontmatter included, for the page to render.

heading.description: One heading: its depth, its text, and the anchor slug GitHub gives it.

text.description: The heading text without its hashes.

slug.description: The GitHub anchor slug for the heading text.

link.description: One link the file makes, as written, with whether it resolves.

target.description: The link target exactly as the document writes it.

status.description: external for a link out of the checkout, ok when it names a tracked file, broken otherwise.
